extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: Add To List on the background, a Background setting. The caption gains a button after the title that puts the film on a list, or on a new one, the same picker the context menu uses. Previous and next buttons at the screen edges, a Background setting. Left and Right from the menu row reach them; Back steps through what has been shown, Next goes forward and then on to a fresh picture, and the timer carries on from there. They work on the picture folder slideshow as well as the library ones.
